cases.prompt: Is the mana curve of my deckbuilder OK? Cards are in cards.csv.
Generate a new card illustration of a space station.
Check tests/fixtures/cards.csv for balance problems: curve, rarity (my targets are 70% common, 20% uncommon, 10% rare) and overstatted cards. Write findings to balance.md.
cases.expect: cw.py curve, rarity --bands, vanilla run; balance.md names the cost-4 gap, Titan and Brute as strong, rarity within bands
